SECRET

Transferred from:-
L.185(608) DS/DyD.

A. Canning Esq., M.V.O., O.B.E.,
Chief Constable,
Special Branch,
New Scotland Yard.

Reference to the attached Report from Security Officer London Area, can you please say what action was subsequently taken? OLDAG or OLDAY (Christian names Arthur William or John) is well known to us. He is a Communist and strongly anti-Nazi and not very reliable, and has been found to be indiscreet. He has published a book called "Kingdom of Rags". We have his photograph.

F. H. Norman

2 October, 1959.
